subject: Sprint prune: unresponsive opportunities — please claim or recycle
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint prune: unresponsive opportunities — please claim or recycle

Team,

Quick heads-up: the finance sprint-prune ran this morning and flagged 23 opportunities in SFDC with zero activity in the last 60 days and no open next step. The export (attached) includes Opportunity ID, ACV, last_activity, and primary contact.

Action requested by EOD Friday 2027-07-02:
- If you own any listed opps, reply to this thread with the Opportunity ID and either (A) a one-line closeproof (PO date / SOW signed / exec approval) or (B) claim ownership and schedule a 15-min sync with the buyer.
- If you do not own and will not pursue, reply "recycle" and we will move the opp to the holdlist.

Priority: RDW-2345 (MedSys Health) shows as no activity but a large ACV. Monica, Jordan — please confirm ownership or next step.

Attachments: SFDC-closeproof-export.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — claiming RDW-2345 (MedSys Health).

Summary: I spoke with Sarah Lim in May; the technical pilot SOW landed with legal but we paused while procurement requested budget alignment. I have an updated SOW and the last customer email thread. Attaching the SOW (MedSys_SOW_v2.pdf). I will schedule a 15-minute touch with Sarah this week to get a clear procurement date and confirm next billing milestone.

- Book 15-min sync with Sarah by 2027-06-28.
- Upload signed SOW to the deal record and drop a note in the HubSpot deal.
- Update SFDC stage to "Commit - Evidence" if we have PO date, else set a follow-up task for 2027-07-09.

Jordan — if you prefer to take this one, let me know and I'll transfer ownership and pass the SOW.

Attachments: MedSys_SOW_v2.pdf

—

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the transparency and the suggested dates.

Decision: We will grant a temporary hold and not recycle RDW-2345 provided the following are completed:
- Monica: book the July 13 15-min sync with Sarah and upload the redlined SOW or a summary note by 2027-07-09.
- Sales ops: flag the deal in SFDC as "Hold - Procurement" with a next task for 2027-07-16.

If we do not receive an update or evidence by 2027-07-16, the deal will be moved to holdlist and marked for recycle. This is aligned with the finance sprint-prune policy (see SUP-789).
